_schema.description: Local commit review metadata for a VS Code extension. Each comment represents feedback left by the user on a specific file and line at the time of a commit. Comments are intended to be addressed by an AI agent. The snapshot field captures surrounding code context at the time the comment was made so the agent can understand the original intent even if the code has since changed. The agent should check this file before starting any task and address all open comments.

fields.commit: The git commit hash the comment was made against
fields.file: Relative path to the file from the repo root
fields.line: Line number at the time of the commit
fields.body: The review comment text written by the user

status.description: Current state of the comment. User and agent have separate ownership of statuses.

values.open: User has left a comment for the agent to address
values.in-progress: Agent is actively working on this comment
values.outdated: Agent detected the code has changed enough that the comment may no longer apply. Requires user review.
values.pending: Agent has questions before it can proceed. Requires user review.
values.resolved: User has confirmed the agents work is acceptable
values.wont-fix: User has decided this comment does not need to be addressed

fields.createdAt: ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was created
fields.resolvedAt: ISO 8601 timestamp when resolved, null if still open
fields.resolvedNote: Written by the agent when updating status. For resolved, explains what was changed and why. For outdated, explains what changed in the code. For pending, contains the agents question for the user. Null if status is open.

snapshot.description: Code context captured at the time of the comment. Use this to understand the original code the comment refers to regardless of how the file has changed since. Compare against current file state to determine if the comment is still relevant.
snapshot.before: Lines immediately preceding the target line, for context
snapshot.target: The specific line or lines the comment is about
snapshot.after: Lines immediately following the target line, for context

comments.resolvedNote: The two-panel layout section originally supported a DiffPanel that had an embedded sidebar (comments list + branches) alongside the main diff area. Since then the architecture was split into separate VS Code WebviewViews — the sidebar panels are now independent providers (CommentsView, ReviewPanel) and the DiffPanel is a single-column editor panel. The #layout and #sidebar CSS still exist in review.css because CommentsView and ReviewPanel reuse the same stylesheet, but they no longer represent an embedded two-panel split inside the diff view. The comment may no longer apply in its original context.

The comment 'This is another thing' doesn't describe an actionable concern. The .sidebar-section-header rule at this line is unchanged from when the comment was made (flex layout, padding, border-bottom, sticky background). Could you clarify what you'd like changed or what the issue is?

The comment 'What about this one?' doesn't describe an actionable concern. The .section-title rule at this line is unchanged (10px uppercase monospace label). Could you clarify what you'd like changed — font size, color, letter-spacing, something else?

The comment 'Hello there' doesn't describe an actionable concern. The reviewedCommits set at this line tracks which commits the user has marked as reviewed (for the 'Mark as reviewed' button). The code is unchanged from when the comment was made. Was this a test comment, or is there something specific you'd like addressed here?
